title: StatusOverlay
description: status.json (docs/snapshot-format.md): the short-lived status overlay, at the root of the public files and never part of a version. Built from the status reports whose change set is published and whose validity window covers generated_at: for each feature, the newest such report. Clients ignore entries for features the loaded version doesn't have, and entries whose valid_until has passed. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: at most one entry per feature_type and feature_id, and valid_until later than valid_from.

entries.description: One entry per feature with an active report. At most 10000.

entry.title: StatusEntry
entry.description: The active status of one node or edge, from a published status report.

feature_id.description: The node's or edge's id in indoor.json.

is_open.description: false: closed (exit shut, lift down). true: open, ending an earlier closure before its valid_until.

note.description: A short public note, for example "Lift under maintenance", or null. Shown to everyone.

valid_until.description: When the status ends, or null for until replaced.

featureType.title: StatusFeatureType
featureType.description: What a status report is about: the feature_type values of status_reports in db/schema.sql.
